# SEO and Public Content
Public learning/editorial pages must be server-readable/crawlable where intended, with truthful metadata, canonical URLs, sitemap/robots consistency and schema types matching actual content. Do not manufacture authority, rankings, NewsArticle status or external-provider eligibility. Preserve anonymous/public reader security boundaries. Content authority comes from provenance, usefulness, internal linking and real subject coverage, not keyword stuffing. Verify mobile reading performance and conversion without hiding core educational content behind client-only loading.
